body:
In a sponsored interview published in the October issue of Institutional Real Estate Americas, Fillmore Capital Partners’ president and CEO Ronald E. Silva, their senior vice president of capital markets Anthony J. Varone, and Brickyard Healthcare’s president and CEO Wesley Rogers describe the stong investment case for Fillmore Healthcare Opportunities and why they believe the next vintage in healthcare may favor operator-led strategies over passive capital.

“In healthcare, performance is earned one day at a time. It is earned through …. thousands of small decisions that either reinforce or weaken the platform. That is why we believe a passive ownership mindset can miss so much. In our business, quality and execution are not separate from financial performance; they drive it. An operator-led lens helps you see where the real pressure points are, where investment should go first and what kind of growth is actually sustainable.”
